description:
Persian calendar
WPF calendar with support for Gregorian and solar calendars
releaseNotes:
Complete automatic Default theme resources

- Make Generic.xaml load the six default control styles without loading every optional theme.
- Supply default palette, typography, editor spacing, icon-font, focus and context-menu resources in the theme-style resource scope.
- Consolidate calendar state brushes and the default day-indicator style in a shared palette.
- Apply navigation button styles explicitly instead of relying on application-level implicit Button styles.
- Preserve the calendar confirmation label's resource expression when supplying its English fallback, allowing later language changes.
- Keep translation resources separate from default visual fallbacks and preserve runtime theme switching.

Resource customization note: default fallback tokens are now owned by theme styles. Set public control appearance properties or override tokens in the control's Resources; application-level string keys do not take precedence over closer style resources.

Atelier theme family

- Add LightAtelier and DarkAtelier variants for all six date and time controls.
- Introduce a calendar navigation rail, separate rounded day cells, a vertical digital clock beside the dial, leading picker buttons, and stacked calendar/time composites.
- Preserve theme switching, translation resources, native digits, calendar event layers, metadata indicators and Hebrew leap-year month rows.
- Format split clock fields independently of TimeFormat separators while preserving editor formatting contracts.
- Append new theme enum values without renumbering existing values.

Layout note: Atelier calendars require at least 420 WPF device-independent pixels in width. Date/time composites and their popups are taller than the existing side-by-side layouts. Clock fields display a fixed 24-hour HH / mm / ss composition; TimeFormat continues to govern the picker editor and the clock's formatted text contract. Calendar direction follows FlowDirection; the dial layout stays left-to-right.

Library language expansion

- Add Arabic (ar), Hebrew (he), Thai (th), Japanese (ja), and Traditional Chinese (zh-Hant) translations alongside Persian and English.
- Centralize built-in language validation and culture resolution. Regional cultures resolve through their culture parents, preserving Chinese script distinctions.
- Traditional Chinese cultures such as zh-TW and zh-HK resolve to zh-Hant. Simplified Chinese and other unsupported cultures use English in automatic selection. Explicit unsupported language selection throws without changing active resources.
- Mark ChangeLanguage obsolete while preserving its existing local-dictionary behavior. Use SetLanguage, SetLanguageFromCulture, or SetLanguageResources for library-wide selection.
- Calendar systems, month/day names, date formatting and FlowDirection remain controlled separately from these four UI labels.

- Fixed an issue where PersianDateTimePicker displayed no border until hovered in the default theme. The control now uses the calendar date-picker palette for its normal background and border, while preserving disabled-state styling and custom border settings.
- Improved calendar UI automation support, including navigation buttons and selections across multiple months. Fixed grid indexing and refreshed automation children after calendar changes.
- Improved calendar day button automation reliability. Invalid dates now preserve the existing selection, detached buttons are handled safely, and disabled-state and column-header checks prevent unexpected behavior.
- add stable automation IDs to calendar buttons
